items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Even when he was with Basie and I was with Barnet, I'd still go out with him every night.

ctx.x: Basie was at the Lincoln. And I'd hang out with Prez all night long, and come into the theatre at ten o'clock in the morning, and couldn't hardly see straight, I'd be so damn tired. But I'd do that, and make that first show with Charlie. It doesn't matter. You go back on out there with Prez, and listen to him play again. Oh, he would play so pretty, man. I just couldn't stand not being around him, and hanging out in New York, too...
Well, that must have been something, though, the grind of doing those shows.
